title: Jensen Huang's affair with alleged spy revives push to tighten China chip curbs ahead of Trump-Xi summit
summary_full: The scandal engulfing Jensen Huang is fueling calls for tighter restrictions on China's access to advanced AI chips, just days before the Trump-Xi summit.
